title: Grand Canyon and Hoover Dam Tour in Spanish - Las Vegas
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
It is the official excursion from Las Vegas to the Grand Canyon with a guide in Spanish.

Transported by van no more than 14 people, VIP group and with direct access inside the Grand Canyon makes it the most exclusive tour in Las Vegas.

A tour that takes us through Hoover Dam and Lake Mead and once in the Grand Canyon we proceed to the natural viewpoint: Eagle Point where the famous glass viewpoint is the Skywalk, and with free time in the Grand Canyon to take pictures and appreciate this natural wonder.

Pickup from your hotel in Las Vegas.
Lunch included.
Professional photos by our guide.
8.5 hours approximately from hotel to hotel.
